name: IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS_
description: IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS stores the joint account owners of a bank account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: PK of this table

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Bank account identifier

columns.name: ACCOUNT_OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to party at HZ_PARTIES_ALL.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date the party's ownership of the account becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date the party's ownership of the account becomes inactive.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating that this is the primary bank account owner

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise identifier to support multi-tenancy.

columns.name: OWNER_VERIF_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Bank account owner verification status. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_OWNER_VERIF_STATUS.

columns.name: LAST_CHANGE_HIST_ID
columns.description: Last change request identifier.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS
columns.description: Bank account owner approval status. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_OWNER_APPROVAL_STATUS.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ORIGIN_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application used to create or update the bank account record.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Actione Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1's and 0s for each row. 1 will be stored if the value has changed and 0 will be stored if the value hasn't.
